forecasts.question: Will a Russian drone, missile or its debris kill anyone on the land territory of a NATO member state by 31 January 2027?
forecasts.resolution_criteria: Yes if the government of a NATO member reports at least one death on its land territory caused by a Russian drone, missile or debris between 2 November 2026 and 31 January 2027.
forecasts.base_rate_note: One deadly case on NATO land since February 2022 (Przewodów, a Ukrainian interceptor), about 5% over 90 days; raised for record incursion tempo and recent blasts near homes in Galați.

forecasts.question: Will NATO aircraft shoot down a drone over Romanian territory or territorial waters by 2 December 2026?
forecasts.resolution_criteria: Yes if Romania's defence ministry reports a NATO or Romanian aircraft shooting down a drone over Romanian land or territorial waters between 2 November and 2 December 2026.
forecasts.base_rate_note: Five shoot-down days over Romania between 24 July and 17 October 2026, about 1.2 a month; lowered slightly because two of them came in a single July surge.

forecasts.question: Will a drone or missile strike a merchant ship inside Romanian or Bulgarian territorial waters by 31 December 2026?
forecasts.resolution_criteria: Yes if Romanian or Bulgarian authorities report a ship hit by a drone or missile inside their 12-mile territorial waters between 2 November and 31 December 2026.
forecasts.base_rate_note: One ship hit inside territorial waters (Yara J, 15 October) and several just outside them since July 2026; raised because the campaign against Danube shipping intensified in October.

forecasts.question: Will a European government publicly attribute a new act of sabotage on its territory to Russia by 31 December 2026?
forecasts.resolution_criteria: Yes if a European government, prosecutor or security service publicly states that Russia or its intelligence services were behind a specific act of sabotage or attempted sabotage on its territory between 2 November and 31 December 2026.
forecasts.base_rate_note: Governments attributed or charged Russian-linked sabotage in most months of 2025–2026, including Germany on 1 September and Romania on 26 October 2026.

forecasts.question: Will Russian military aircraft violate Estonian or Finnish airspace by 31 January 2027?
forecasts.resolution_criteria: Yes if the Estonian Defence Forces or the Finnish defence ministry reports a Russian military or state aircraft entering their national airspace without permission between 2 November 2026 and 31 January 2027.
forecasts.base_rate_note: Seven Russian aircraft violations of Estonian or Finnish airspace from May 2025 to August 2026, about 0.3 a month, or 60% over 90 days.

forecasts.question: Will an undersea cable or gas pipeline in the Baltic Sea be damaged by 31 March 2027?
forecasts.resolution_criteria: Yes if a Baltic Sea state or the operator reports physical damage to an undersea telecom cable, power cable or gas pipeline in the Baltic Sea between 2 November 2026 and 31 March 2027.
forecasts.base_rate_note: Six Baltic cable or pipeline damage events from October 2023 to December 2025, clustered in winter; about 55% over five months.

forecasts.question: Will the Zaporizhzhia nuclear power plant lose all off-site power again by 31 January 2027?
forecasts.resolution_criteria: Yes if the IAEA reports that the Zaporizhzhia plant lost all off-site power, even briefly, between 2 November 2026 and 31 January 2027.
forecasts.base_rate_note: The plant lost all off-site power 26 times from August 2022 to August 2026, about once every two months; slightly lower while IAEA-brokered repairs hold.
forecasts.resolution_note: The IAEA said Zaporizhzhia lost its only remaining off-site line, Ferosplavna-1, on 8 November. This was its 27th total loss of off-site power. Power was restored hours later.

resolution_source.title: Ukraine's Zaporizhzhya nuclear plant loses all external power for 27th time: UN nuclear watchdog

forecasts.question: Will a Russian drone or missile injure or kill anyone in Moldova by 31 January 2027?
forecasts.resolution_criteria: Yes if Moldovan authorities report at least one person injured or killed by a Russian drone, missile or debris on Moldovan territory between 2 November 2026 and 31 January 2027.
forecasts.base_rate_note: Two incidents with injuries in Moldova in October 2026 and none recorded before; raised for the October tempo of crashes near homes.

forecasts.question: Will NATO hold Article 4 consultations at an ally's request by 30 April 2027?
forecasts.resolution_criteria: Yes if NATO confirms consultations under Article 4 of the North Atlantic Treaty requested by any ally between 2 November 2026 and 30 April 2027.
forecasts.base_rate_note: Article 4 was invoked three times since February 2022 (February 2022, and by Poland and Estonia in September 2025), about 25% over six months.

forecasts.question: Will Russian armed forces cross a NATO member's land border by 30 April 2027?
forecasts.resolution_criteria: Yes if a NATO member's government reports Russian armed forces personnel deliberately crossing its land border on duty, excluding defectors and border-marker disputes. Belarusian forces alone don't count.
forecasts.base_rate_note: No such crossing since 2022; the closest cases were Russian border guards removing Estonian buoys on the Narva river in 2024.

forecasts.question: Will Russia and Ukraine agree a general ceasefire covering the whole front line by 30 June 2027?
forecasts.resolution_criteria: Yes if both governments announce a ceasefire covering all front lines that takes effect between 2 November 2026 and 30 June 2027; partial energy or local truces do not count.
forecasts.base_rate_note: No general ceasefire in 56 months of war despite repeated talks; partial truces (energy, local, IAEA-brokered) have not held.

forecasts.question: Will Latvia's armed forces report a drone entering Latvian airspace from Russia or Belarus between 3 November and 2 December 2026?
forecasts.resolution_criteria: Yes if Latvia's National Armed Forces or Defence Ministry reports an unmanned aircraft entering Latvian airspace from Russia or Belarus between 3 November and 2 December 2026, whether or not its origin is identified.
forecasts.base_rate_note: Latvia reported drone entries or crashes in March, June and August 2026, plus on 24 October and 1 November: about 0.5 a month, or roughly 40% over 30 days. Raised for the late-October cluster.

updates.note: Latvia's armed forces reported a drone entering over Balvi and Ludza, on the Russian border, on 3 November. We await confirmation of where it entered from.

forecasts.question: Will the US government announce a further reduction of US forces in European NATO countries between 3 November and 31 December 2026?
forecasts.resolution_criteria: Yes if the White House or Pentagon announces a withdrawal, a cancelled rotation or a permanent reduction of US forces stationed in a European NATO country between 3 November and 31 December 2026.
forecasts.base_rate_note: There were two such announcements in about 14 months: the Romania brigade withdrawal and the cancelled Poland–Romania rotation. That is about 25% over two months. Raised for allied fears reported before the midterms.

forecasts.question: Will Polish authorities report sabotage, attempted sabotage or an armed-group crossing at Poland's border with Kaliningrad between 3 and 30 November 2026?
forecasts.resolution_criteria: Yes if Polish police, prosecutors, Border Guard, armed forces or ministers report an act or attempted act of sabotage, or an armed group crossing, on or near the Polish–Kaliningrad border between 3 and 30 November 2026.
forecasts.base_rate_note: We know of no reported sabotage at the Kaliningrad border since 2022; Russian-linked sabotage elsewhere in Poland comes a few times a year. Raised for the allied warning behind the 2–8 November readiness order.

updates.note: Tusk says Poland prevented a possible provocation at the Kaliningrad border on 3 November. No crossing was attempted, but the threat is now described as current.
The 2–8 November warning window passed with no reported sabotage or crossing at the Kaliningrad border. The threat period Tusk cited runs to mid-November.

forecasts.question: Will the IAEA report that a Ukrainian nuclear plant other than Zaporizhzhia cut output or lost an off-site power line because of military activity by 31 December 2026?
forecasts.resolution_criteria: Yes if an IAEA statement or update reports that Khmelnytskyi, Rivne or South Ukraine nuclear plant reduced power output or lost one or more off-site power lines because of military activity between 4 November and 31 December 2026.
forecasts.base_rate_note: The IAEA reported such cuts several times during Russia's winter grid campaigns of 2024–25 and 2025–26, about every two months. Raised for the drones aimed at a Khmelnytskyi substation on 3 November.

updates.note: Zelensky says substations connecting the Rivne and Khmelnytskyi plants to Kyiv were struck on 6–7 November. We await an IAEA statement on output or lines.

forecasts.question: Will delegations of Russia, Ukraine and the United States hold trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi between 5 and 20 November 2026?
forecasts.resolution_criteria: Yes if at least two of the three governments, or credible wire reporting, confirm that Russian, Ukrainian and US delegations met in a trilateral format in Abu Dhabi between 5 and 20 November 2026.
forecasts.base_rate_note: Announced 2026 talks have often slipped. The Kremlin declined the round expected in October. Raised because Zelensky and the Kyiv Independent both give a date less than a week away.

updates.note: The Moscow Times reports a US delegation is due to mediate Russian–Ukrainian talks in Abu Dhabi on 10–11 November; Trump met Dmitriev and says a deal could come soon.
Zelensky says Russia is preparing for 'the trilateral talks' with strikes, which signals that Kyiv expects the round to go ahead.
Estonia's foreign minister refers to 'this week's' US-mediated Abu Dhabi talks, which is a further sign that the round is going ahead.

forecasts.question: Will Moldova's defence ministry report at least 10 airspace violations by drones in November 2026?
forecasts.resolution_criteria: Yes if Moldova's Ministry of Defence or National Army reports, in daily statements or a monthly summary, at least 10 unauthorised drone violations of Moldovan airspace dated 1–30 November 2026.
forecasts.base_rate_note: Moldova reported a record 19 violations in October, after fewer in earlier months. One was reported on 4 November. Russia's winter strikes on Odesa and the south continue.

forecasts.question: Will Romanian authorities state by 20 November 2026 that the drone fragments found in Boghicea, Neamț county, on 5 November came from a Russian drone?
forecasts.resolution_criteria: Yes if Romania's Ministry of National Defence, SRI, police or prosecutors publicly say between 6 and 20 November 2026 that the Boghicea fragments are of Russian origin or from a Geran-type drone.
forecasts.base_rate_note: MApN has usually identified Russian drone debris in Tulcea and Galați within days. Lowered because Neamț is far from usual routes, no ministry statement has appeared yet, and some finds stay unidentified.

forecasts.question: Will the IAEA report that the Zaporizhzhia nuclear power plant lost all off-site power between 10 November and 31 December 2026?
forecasts.resolution_criteria: Yes if an IAEA statement or update reports that the Zaporizhzhia plant lost all off-site power, even briefly, at any time between 10 November and 31 December 2026.
forecasts.base_rate_note: 27 total losses in about 51 months, roughly 0.5 a month, or about 35% over 52 days. We raised it because the plant now depends on a single line and Russia's winter grid campaign is under way.
